\[
S(r)=\frac{12}{1-r}.
\]
Thus
\[
S(a)=\frac{12}{1-a},\qquad S(-a)=\frac{12}{1+a}.
\]
Their product is
\[
S(a)S(-a)=\frac{12}{1-a}\cdot\frac{12}{1+a}
      =\frac{144}{1-a^{2}}.
\]
We are given that \(S(a)S(-a)=2016\), so
\[
\frac{144}{1-a^{2}}=2016 \;\Longrightarrow\; 1-a^{2}= \frac{144}{2016}= \frac{1}{14}.
\]
Hence
\[
a^{2}=1-\frac{1}{14}= \frac{13}{14}.
\]
Now compute \(S(a)+S(-a)\):
\[
S(a)+S(-a)=\frac{12}{1-a}+\frac{12}{1+a}=12\cdot\frac{(1+a)+(1-a)}{(1-a)(1+a)}
           =12\cdot\frac{2}{1-a^{2}}.
\]
Since \(1-a^{2}= \frac{1}{14}\),
\[
S(a)+S(-a)=12\cdot\frac{2}{1/14}=12\cdot 28=336.
\]
